enchantment.icraft.heatward.desc: Reduces fire and lava damage by 8%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.voidward.desc: Reduces void, wither, and out-of-world damage by 8%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.depthstrider_custom.d: Reduces damage taken below Y=0 by 10%% per level (cap 80%%).
enchantment.icraft.aether_acclimation.de: Negates the Aether's thin-air debuffs (Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue) up to Y=192 + 32 per level.
enchantment.icraft.warp_shield.desc: Reduces the chance of ender displacement in The End by 5%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.prospector.desc: Mining ore has a 10%% chance per level to drop an extra of the same ore. Stacks with Fortune.
enchantment.icraft.lumberjack.desc: Breaking a log fells the connected tree (up to 16 logs per level).
enchantment.icraft.momentum.desc: Consecutive melee hits stack +2%% attack speed (cap 5 stacks per level). Decays after 5s without a hit.
enchantment.icraft.adrenaline.desc: Deals +6%% damage per level while below 30%% HP.
enchantment.icraft.titan_slayer.desc: Deals +4%% damage per level against enemies above 100 max HP, scaling with their HP (cap +20%% per level).
enchantment.icraft.crowd_control.desc: Deals +5%% damage per level for each nearby hostile mob within 3 blocks (cap 5 mobs).
enchantment.icraft.adaptive.desc: After taking 3 hits of the same damage type, gain 3%% damage reduction per level per additional hit (cap 30%%). Decays over time.
enchantment.icraft.boss_ward.desc: Reduces damage taken from boss enemies by 5%% per level (cap 80%%).
enchantment.icraft.steadfast.desc: Grants +15%% knockback resistance per level while a boss is within 32 blocks.
enchantment.icraft.nemesis.desc: Deals +3%% damage per stack against the same boss type, gaining 1 stack per hit (cap 10 stacks per level). Stacks persist per boss type.
enchantment.icraft.mana_temper.desc: Deals +8%% melee damage per level while a spell book, staff, wand, or mana focus is held in the offhand.
enchantment.icraft.rf_capacitance.desc: Reduces damage taken by 4%% per level while carrying an energy storage item (cell, capacitor, battery, energy cube, flux item).
enchantment.icraft.convergence.desc: Boosts spell power per level based on the held weapon's material tier: Iron +5%%, Steel/Manasteel +10%%, Diamond/Terrasteel +15%%, Netherite +20%%.
enchantment.icraft.primal_force.desc: Deals up to +3%% damage per level scaling with current food saturation (cap +15%% per level at full saturation).
enchantment.icraft.magnetism.desc: Pulls dropped items toward you. Range = 2 + 1.5 blocks per level.
enchantment.icraft.last_stand.desc: On a hit that would kill you, survive at 1 HP and gain Absorption + 2s invulnerability. 5-minute cooldown.
enchantment.icraft.vitality.desc: Adds +2 max HP for each total Vitality level across all armor pieces.
enchantment.icraft.phalanx.desc: Reduces damage taken by 6%% per level while actively blocking with a shield (cap 90%%).
enchantment.icraft.quick_draw.desc: Increases attack speed by 15%% per level while holding a bow or crossbow (proxy for draw speed).
enchantment.icraft.lunar_stride.desc: On Ad Astra planets: grants Jump Boost and reduces fall damage by 33%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.thermal_regulation.de: Reduces cold damage on Mars (night), Mercury (dark side), and Glacio by 33%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.pressure_shell.desc: Reduces Venus acid-rain damage by 50%% per level.
enchantment.icraft.void_adaptation.desc: Negates the Mining Fatigue debuff applied in extreme environments such as Glacio.
enchantment.icraft.stellar_shield.desc: Reduces fire and lava damage on Ad Astra planets by 33%% per level.
Healing potions are only 50% effective on your scaled hide.
power.icraft.origin/demi-god/cursed.name: Nether Sickness
power.icraft.origin/demi-god/cursed.desc: The Nether weakens your divine blood, but you can fight through it.
power.icraft.origin/demi-god/fire.name: Fire Vulnerability
power.icraft.origin/demi-god/fire.descri: Fire burns 50% hotter against your divine form.
power.icraft.origin/demi-god/raw_meat_bu: Raw meat gives 2x nourishment. Cooked meat gives 1.5x.
power.icraft.origin/fallen-angel/velocit: Launch yourself forward, leaving a withering cloud.
power.icraft.origin/fallen-angel/roof.de: Slower under roofs. The memory of confinement haunts you.
